headlines.text: S&P 500 climbs 0.36% and Nasdaq gains 0.83% on a chip-stock rally while the Dow slips about 0.4% as Apple's margin warning weighs
AMD posts record $13.38 billion Q3 revenue as data-center sales nearly double on AI chip demand, and guides Q4 revenue above Wall Street estimates to about $17 billion
Apple falls about 2.5% and Palantir drops roughly 4% intraday even after both topped earnings estimates, as investors fret over margins and valuation
Shopify tumbles roughly 15% and Dynatrace sinks 17% on disappointing results, while Grab jumps 10% after raising its full-year outlook
Oil prices climb after the US reportedly strikes Iran's Qeshm Island overnight, reviving Mideast escalation fears on US Election Day
Senate control is a razor-thin toss-up as midterm polls close, with prediction-market traders flipping between Democratic and Republican leads in the final hours
